parent_objective: design additive merge/export tool for M1322 and M1327 source rows
blocked_by: M1328 admits additive merge but requires explicit source identity and dedupe diagnostics before export
supersedes: direct source-history materialization from M1322 or M1327 alone

public_gates: M1329 must not use private holdout
M1329 must preserve actor input contract
M1329 must define semantic duplicate diagnostics
M1329 must keep halfshaft and global friction blockers explicit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not fabricate global friction coverage
do not export without source-run-prefixed identity
do not silently drop semantic duplicates

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the additive merge/export implementation after M1328 audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design omits source-run-prefixed identity
stop if design hides halfshaft or global friction blockers
stop if design routes directly to source-history materialization
stop if design changes actor inputs
fallback_plan: if merge/export design is feasible, implement one no-policy merge/export tool
if source schemas cannot be normalized, write a schema adapter audit
if merge identity is ambiguous, implement preview diagnostics before final export

training_stage.stage_objective: source top-up additive merge export design
blocked_shortcuts: do not materialize histories before merge export and plan refresh
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1329 designs source export and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design merged source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If merge/export design is not feasible, record source schema blockers rather than training anyway.
allowed_claims: source top-up additive merge export design
no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A no-policy merge/export tool can be designed to combine M1322 and M1327 source rows with safe source identity and explicit duplicate diagnostics.
success_criteria: design routes to one no-policy merge/export implementation
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design hides halfshaft or global friction blockers
design routes directly to materialization or PPO
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1329 passes if it designs merge/export implementation with source-run-prefixed identity and duplicate diagnostics without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, hidden blockers, or actor-input expansion.
